name: MySims Agents
author: Addicting Games
description: Ready for a new MySims adventure? Prepare to battle Morcubus, the lord of the criminal underworld. Recruit other special agents to build your sleuthing dream team. Search for clues, hack computers, pick locks and solve devious puzzles. Adventure through ancient temples and ski chalets as you collect evidence and handy secret devices! Can you and your team outwit Morcubus?
